logged.notes: lower back hurt a bit from doing rdl

thread.text:
Today: Squat held at 80kg for 5, 5, 5, identical to 11-22, no knee complaints noted. RDL climbed to 80kg x 8, 8, 7, up from 7, 7, 7 last time — two of three sets now at the top of the range. Leg extension came in at 10kg x 10, 10, 10, down from the 12, 12 you hit on 11-22. Nordic curl replaced kneeling leg curl, as the prescription allows. Calf raise and hanging leg raise aren't in the log today.

Sleep: 7h23 the night before, HRV 128ms, 47bpm asleep — both above the week's average of 7h18 and HRV 118. No normal yet to measure against (13 of 14 nights needed), but nothing here looks like a thin night.

Trend: squat has now given 80kg x 5, 5, 5 with quiet knees on both 11-22 and today — that's the second session the progression rule asked for, so the load should move to 82.5kg next Sunday. RDL is tracking toward 82.5kg too, one set away (needs 8s across all three, currently 8, 8, 7).

Rounding: calf raise has missed two of the last three Lowers (11-15, today), and hanging leg raise hasn't shown up in a Lower log since 10-02 — it's logged on Upper C instead. Not a problem if it's getting done unlogged, just worth knowing which it is.

Question: the note says the lower back hurt a bit from the RDL — was that still bothering you through leg extension, or is the drop to 10, 10, 10 just an off day unrelated to it?

Next session: Upper C, Sat 28 Nov. Keep the flat call (30kg press, 20kg row, 5kg lateral) if Thursday's tiredness is still hanging around. Separately, carry 82.5kg into next Sunday's squat given two clean 5, 5, 5 sessions with quiet knees.
